mentions.name: BetterCapture
mentions.description: This is a lightweight (~4MB, low memory/CPU footprint) screen recorder for macOS that lives in the menu bar. It supports ProRes 422/4444, HEVC, and H.264 with alpha channel and HDR, frame rates from 24 to 120fps, and simultaneous system audio and microphone capture, and can exclude items like the menu bar, dock, or wallpaper from recordings. It has no tracking, analytics, cloud uploads, or accounts (MIT licensed, everything stays local), and a plugin system is planned so others can contribute new functionality while keeping the core app small.

mentions.name: BetterCapture
mentions.description: This is a lightweight macOS screen recorder that lives in the menu bar. It uses SwiftUI and ScreenCaptureKit with the native Content Picker for selecting recording targets, supports ProRes 422/4444, HEVC, and H.264 (including alpha channel and HDR) at 24-120fps, captures system audio and mic simultaneously, and can exclude elements like the menu bar, dock, or wallpaper. It collects no tracking or analytics, performs no cloud uploads, requires no account, and is MIT licensed with everything staying on the local Mac.
